# Positive-sequence collapse fixture

This pedagogical fixture is the positive companion to the book's
`transposition-implies-positive-sequence-exactness` misconception. A circulant
three-phase series matrix has an invariant positive-sequence subspace, and its
scalar eigenvalue is reproduced by the target. The declarations explicitly
restrict boundary data, grounding, devices, decisions, and observations to the
balanced positive-sequence domain.

The passing result is intentionally narrow. It does not certify an unbalanced
feeder, phase-specific limits, neutral/earth or protection quantities, internal
device behavior, complete feasible sets, objectives, or solver results.
